reviews.title: Worked well with the steam deck
reviews.comment:
The WD_BLACK 2TB SN770M M.2 2230 NVMe SSD is a standout option for gamers and tech enthusiasts seeking a reliable and high-performance storage solution. As an upgrade for devices like the Steam Deck, this SSD excels in both performance and convenience.
Performance
The SN770M offers impressive read and write speeds, making it perfect for demanding applications like gaming. With sequential read speeds of up to 5,150 MB/s and write speeds reaching 4,900 MB/s, it drastically reduces load times, enhances system responsiveness, and provides a smoother gaming experience. This performance uplift is particularly noticeable in the Steam Deck, where game load times can be significantly reduced, and multitasking becomes more efficient.
Compatibility
The SN770M's M.2 2230 form factor ensures it fits perfectly into the Steam Deck's SSD slot. The installation process is straightforward, and the drive's compatibility with the latest PCIe Gen4 interfaces means users can fully leverage the Steam Deck's hardware capabilities. For those concerned about compatibility issues, the SN770M integrates seamlessly with the Steam Deck, requiring minimal setup effort.
Capacity
With a generous 2TB of storage, the SN770M offers ample space for a large library of games, multimedia files, and other applications. This capacity is particularly beneficial for Steam Deck users who want to carry a vast collection of games without worrying about running out of storage space.
Durability and Reliability
WD_BLACK products are known for their durability and reliability, and the SN770M is no exception. It features advanced thermal management technologies to prevent overheating, ensuring consistent performance even during extended gaming sessions. Additionally, Western Digital's reputation for quality and robust customer support adds an extra layer of confidence in the product's longevity.
Gaming Experience on the Steam Deck
Upgrading a Steam Deck with the WD_BLACK SN770M transforms the handheld gaming experience. Games launch quicker, and in-game transitions are smoother. The increased storage allows for a broader selection of games to be installed simultaneously, catering to both casual gamers and those who like to switch between different titles frequently. The overall performance boost makes the Steam Deck feel more responsive and capable, bridging the gap between portable and desktop gaming.
Conclusion
The WD_BLACK 2TB SN770M M.2 2230 NVMe SSD is an excellent upgrade for the Steam Deck. It offers a substantial performance boost, ample storage capacity, and reliable operation, enhancing the overall gaming experience. For Steam Deck owners looking to maximize their device's potential, this SSD upgrade is a highly recommended investment.

reviews.title: Great drive at a great price with a great, known brand.
reviews.comment:
Western Digital makes quality hard drives, period.  The performance is always good, they always seem to work and the cost is better than buying from the computer manufacturer.
I purchased this for my college freshman's new laptop.  You couldn't get anything more than a 512G hard drive and that wasn't going to be enough.  Installing was easy after we figured out how to open the laptop housing.  The WD drive fit as expected and worked perfectly after we made a direct backup of the original drive.  Compatibility was never an issue and 2tb of capacity was exactly what we needed.

reviews.title: Massive upgrade for my Steam Deck
reviews.comment:
Massive upgrade for my Steam Deck!
I installed the WD_BLACK SN770M 2TB in my Steam Deck, and it’s been amazing. The install was super easy, and the speed difference is instantly noticeable — games load fast and everything feels smoother. Having 2TB of space means I can keep my whole library on deck without worrying about running out of room.
It runs cool, performs great, and so far has been rock solid. If you’re thinking about upgrading your Steam Deck’s storage, this drive is 100% worth it.
